message.content: I don't think it's necessarily bad that it switched to checking if the data that was cut short was good or not, that may be part of the generation work, dealing with a failure that happened in it's scope, that's fine, I just wanted to know where the tokens went. I agree with the figure reading part

content.text:
Joaquin, understood. I'll drop the scope change: a failure inside the generation, including checking whether the data it produced is sound, stays with the generation agent. The context threshold handles length by closing the agent with a hand-off, as it did twice tonight. The figure rule goes into D as agreed: a figure is looked at once per version, at low resolution.

That leaves nothing waiting on you until the A and B diffs are ready. Sleep well.
